title: Additivity of Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $\pi$, and let $\{\phi_a:a\in\iota\}$ be a finite orthonormal basis of real functions on $\Omega$ in the $\pi$-weighted inner product, with a constant-one basis vector indexed by $0$. For any nonnegative integer $n$, functions $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and product Fourier index $a\in\iota^n$, the Fourier coefficient of $f+g$ at $a$ is the sum of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ and $g$ at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: probability measure on the sample space
orthonormal real-function basis with a constant-one basis vector
functions f and g on the product space
